hyps.why: Edge 4 lies on path 0->1->3, which is dead when edge 0 is none, so the conv adds nothing.
Edge 5 is only useful if node 2 receives input, and with edge 1 none it depends on the longer path via edges 0 and 2.
Edge 0 feeds node 1, whose only exits are edges 2 and 4, so with edge 4 none its benefit is reduced.
Edge 1 feeds node 2, which reaches the output only via edge 5, so with edge 5 none the conv is mostly wasted.
Replacing none with a conv gives a larger gain than replacing a skip connection, which is already a strong direct path.
Adding a skip where the edge was none gains a lot, while swapping a conv for skip is neutral or harmful.
Going from none to conv is a bigger gain than replacing an existing parametric or pooling op.
Replacing a skip connection with a 1x1 conv gives little or negative gain, versus a large gain from none.
Without the direct edge 3, indirect conv paths carry all the signal, so improving them matters more.
With edge 0 none, node 1 receives no input and edge 4 contributes nothing.
